charts.title: Search brings most new customers, so it drives the total
charts.subtitle: New customers by sign-up channel, first orders Oct 2023 to Sep 2025.

findings: Across all channels, 19.6% of new customers placed a second order within 12 months (4,539 of 23,146).
Channels differ little over the full period: Organic is highest at 20.6%, Search is 19.5% and Display is lowest at 18.3%.
Repeat rates have climbed across the board, from 15.9% for the Oct 2023 cohort to 26.6% for the Sep 2025 cohort; the data shows the rise but not the cause.
In the latest three cohorts (Jul to Sep 2025), Organic is at 29.4% and Display at 28.3%, while Email (21.2%) and Facebook (21.7%) are lower.
Search brought 16,335 of the 23,146 new customers, so it sets the overall rate; Display has only 854 customers and many months with fewer than 30, so its rate can swing a lot.
Channel is the sign-up channel, which may differ from the channel of the first purchase, and there is no spend data, so this cannot show which channel gives the best return on budget.
